subject: Token commit matrix & proposed terms
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@streamlineapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Token commit matrix & proposed terms

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Per our discussion I put together an initial token-commit matrix and a short terms draft so you and procurement can evaluate the options quickly. The intent is to provide three simple annual commit tiers that map to expected monthly usage bands, with clear per-token discounts and a simple credit/fallback mechanism if volume misses targets.

Attachments (quick stubs):
- commit-matrix-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — tier ranges, suggested list price, discount %, sample monthly ramp
- redwood-commit-terms-draft.pdf (PDF) — payment cadence, overage handling, early-exit credit rules

High level (starter sketch):
- Starter: 1M tokens/year — small discount for predictable usage, month-to-month PO acceptable
- Growth: 10M tokens/year — mid-tier discount, prepay/PO recommended, 30-day SLA credit threshold
- Enterprise: 100M+ tokens/year — largest discount, reserved capacity path, annual PO + SOW

Open questions for you and procurement:
- Is there a minimum commit term you require (12 vs 24 months)?
- Do you need an explicit data-residency clause or KMS integration called out in the SOW?
- Are seat-based admin licenses or rate-limited call quotas part of your commercial needs?

If useful, Marissa and I can run numbers on a blended effective rate per 1k tokens for each tier and share a short one-pager. Would you be available for a 30-min sync Tues or Wed next week to walk procurement through the matrix?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@streamlineapps.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Streamline Apps Procurement <procurement@streamlineapps.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T10:15:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Token commit matrix & proposed terms

Karthik —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the spreadsheet. A few immediate questions from procurement and engineering:

1) Minimum term — procurement prefers 12 months, but for larger discounts they will consider 24 months.
2) Data residency — we need confirmation that logs and KV cache do not leave our specified AWS region (us-east-1). If Redwood can provide a region-bound private deployment for Enterprise, that helps.
3) Seat licenses — we have two platform admins; can those be bundled at no extra charge for Growth+?

Also: what is the mechanism for token reconciliation? We need monthly usage statements and the ability to dispute within 30 days.

Happy to take a 30-min call Wednesday (9/23) at 11am ET if you can confirm Marissa or Connor will join to speak to pricing flex.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of ML Products
Streamline Apps

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@streamlineapps.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-23T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Token commit matrix & proposed terms

Rachel / Karthik —

Thanks for the feedback, Rachel. A few clarifications and a counter we think will map to Streamline's needs while keeping the price ladder simple:

- Minimum term: we can do 12 months for Starter/Growth; Enterprise picks up 12 or 24. For Enterprise >50M tokens/year we can offer a 24-month option with an incremental 3% additional discount.
- Data residency: For Enterprise we can offer a VPC-backed private deployment (us-east-1) and a KMS integration. We'll put the exact language in SOW/Annex A.
- Admin seats: For Growth and above we will include up to 3 admin seats at no additional cost.
- Token reconciliation: monthly usage export + CSV reconciliation. We run a tolerance window of 2% on system-reported usage; disputes supported up to 30 days with an audit log export.

Pricing counter (indicative, annualized):
- Starter (1M tokens/yr): List price baseline, ~10% discount off list (suitable for PoC/proof-of-value).
- Growth (10M tokens/yr): ~22% discount off list, includes admin seats + 30-day SLA credits.
- Enterprise (100M+ tokens/yr): ~38% discount off list, reserved capacity routing + priority capacity, optional 24-month with +3% discount.

I'll attach a quick revised matrix after the call (commit-matrix-v2) that reflects these numbers and the simple fallback (credits) if usage is below 80% of commit at year-end.

Karthik — I'll join Wed 11am ET. Connor — please bring the template SOW language for region/KMS. Rachel — sending a calendar invite now.

-Marissa
Head of Sales, US
Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: commit-matrix-v2.xlsx (draft)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@streamlineapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-24T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Token commit matrix & proposed terms

Rachel — great, thanks for the quick clarifications and for looping procurement. Agenda for Wed 11am ET: 1) Walk the v2 matrix, 2) Confirm residency/KMS language and next steps for SOW, 3) PO path & timelines.

Mutual action plan (draft):
- Wed 9/23 11am ET: sync to finalize tier and confirm SOW ask (calendar invite sent).
- By 9/28: Redwood provides final contract redline and the formal pricing table + annex for data residency.
- By 10/05: Streamline issues PO for selected tier or flags changes for negotiation.

We will also surface a sample invoice and the monthly usage CSV format for reconciliation so procurement can review offline. If you're happy, I'll include Connor to draft Annex A and our legal team will issue the initial redline.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
